subject: Exec: Streaming chunked transfer hang - Onward Apps escalation
messages:
From: Theresa Nguyen <theresa@onwardapps.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Streaming responses hang intermittently - chunked transfer stalls

Laura / Sean,

We're seeing a regression starting yesterday afternoon across our production traffic: ~6-9% of streaming responses never finish — the HTTP response stays open and the client shows the last chunk but no final close. It affects both chunked-transfer responses and WebSocket sessions (close never arrives). Restarting the client occasionally recovers, but this is impacting our UX and throughput.

Symptoms:
- 200 responses where final chunk not sent, client hangs for >30s then times out
- WebSocket sessions stay ESTABLISHED; connection-level PINGs are unanswered in the same window
- Error surface on our side: stalled_stream and occasionally 502 gateway errors

We pushed a backup switch to non-streaming endpoints (polling) which reduced visible failures but introduced latency regressions. Can you triage urgently? We can share logs and packet capture. We're ready to jump on a call — this is customer-impacting for a large cohort.

Thanks,
Theresa
Director, Platform
Onward Apps
From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Theresa Nguyen <theresa@onwardapps.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Streaming responses hang intermittently - chunked transfer stalls

Theresa,

Thanks for the heads up — really sorry for the disruption. We're prioritizing this and I'll coordinate the triage. Two quick asks that will speed diagnosis:
1) Could you attach 2–3 example request IDs and the timeframe (UTC) where you saw the hangs?
2) If possible, a short pcap (server/client side) around one incident would be ideal.

In the interim:
- Please keep the non-streaming fallback enabled for affected customers (we'll try to limit this to the impacted route).
- We're going to run an emergency investigation with the streaming gateway + load balancer teams.

I'll loop in engineering leads and update you in the next 90 minutes with a mitigation plan.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Streaming responses hang intermittently - URGENT customer escalation (Onward Apps)

Team — forwarding Onward's artifacts (attached). Summary: customer is seeing a persistent class of streaming hangs affecting chunked transfer and WebSocket streams. They have fallen back to polling, which hurts latency. This is a strategic customer (DEAL-8421).

Impact: customer-visible errors, increased support load, exec attention on both sides.

Immediate asks:
- Marissa: can you triage gateway logs (streaming dispatcher + nginx/proxy layer) for the supplied request IDs and confirm whether the server emitted final chunk / close frames?
- Sean: please check routing path and any recent infra changes to the streaming layer (timeouts, keepalive, proxy upgrades).
- Rishi / Hannah: FYI — I may need signoff for proactive credits and a customer-facing timeline.

I'll coordinate with Onward for a 1:1 bridge if you need it.

Laura
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Streaming responses hang intermittently - initial triage

Quick initial notes from a fast triage on the two request IDs:
- Server commit did generate the final chunk and set Content-Length=chunked close; however the streaming gateway did not forward the final FIN to the upstream client connection in ~15% of sampled traces.
- We see clustering of failures behind a particular edge proxy tier (edge-nginx-4b) that had a config bump 4 hours before the first incidents. The bump modified keepalive and proxy_buffering flags.
- WebSocket paths show stalled PONG responses from the upstream proxy in the same window.

Proposed immediate mitigations (short-lived):
1) Temporarily route Onward traffic to alternative edge pool (edge-nginx-7) that has the previous keepalive settings (low risk, immediate).
2) Increase streaming gateway idle timeout to 90s while we patch the proxy config and add a safety check to force a chunk/close on no-ack after 30s to avoid indefinite hanging.
3) Enable additional connection-level observability (tcp dump & streaming trace) for Onward for the next 48 hours.

I'll start a rollback of the config on edge-nginx-4b if we get approval. Need Ops to run the route change — Sean, can you coordinate?

- Marissa
Senior SRE, Serving Runtime
From: sean_gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 07:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Streaming responses hang - canary + ops plan

I've scheduled the routing switch to edge-nginx-7 as a canary at 08:15 PDT (2026-10-02T15:15:00Z) for 15 minutes, then progressive rollout if stable. Ops runbook steps:
- Stage 1: add Onward alias to edge-nginx-7 and monitor request success rate and streaming closure metric for +5m windows.
- Stage 2: if no new hangs detected, promote for 50% traffic for 30m, then 100% over 2h.
- Stage 3: apply proxy config rollback on edge-nginx-4b, deploy 90s idle timeout on streaming gateway as protective patch.

PagerDuty incident: PD-8812. Runbook and incident notes here: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-8812
HubSpot: HUBSPOT-8421 for customer communication.

I'll stand by for approval to run stage 1 now. If approved, I'll open the canary and monitor dashboards.

-Sean
From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Theresa Nguyen <theresa@onwardapps.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@onwardapps.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 18:04:00 -0700
Subject: Exec summary & customer communication plan — Onward Apps (streaming hang)

Hannah / Rishi,

Summary: Onward Apps (DEAL-8421) reported intermittent streaming hangs (chunked transfer & WebSocket) beginning 2026-09-30. Fast triage identified a recent edge proxy config change (edge-nginx-4b) that correlates with the incidents. Marissa's team can route traffic to an alternate edge pool and deploy a temporary gateway timeout to prevent indefinite hangs.

Planned next steps (approved by SRE):
- Immediate: run canary routing to edge-nginx-7 (Sean will execute stage 1).
- Near-term fix: rollback offending proxy change on edge-nginx-4b and deploy 90s streaming idle timeout.
- Monitoring: enable tcp dumps and request-level traces for the customer for 48h.

Customer asks: incident timeline, mitigation ETA, and compensation for downtime. Onward is asking for an incident brief for their execs.

Requested approvals:
1) Authorization to run the canary rollout now (low-risk) — required for Stage 1.
2) Authorization to offer a one-time service credit up to 6% of last month spend if we confirm customer impact after full forensic review.

If approved, I'll send Onward a short incident notification and schedule a 30-minute bridge for Monday to walk through the root cause and remediation.

Laura Bennett
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
